description: List available server specifications for NKS cluster/node pool creation. Requires softwareCode (from ncloud_nks_get_server_images) and zoneCode or zoneNo.

zoneCode.description: Zone code (e.g., KR-1). Required if zoneNo not provided.

zoneNo.description: Zone number. Required if zoneCode not provided.

name: ncloud_nks_get_server_specs
